evals.prompt: I'm building a tech blog and need some high-quality landscape photos of modern office workspaces for my hero sections. Also need a few short background videos. Find me some options.
evals.expected_output: Should call the Pexels REST API (GET /v1/search with orientation=landscape, GET /v1/videos/search for videos) using ${PEXELS_API_KEY}. May also suggest Unsplash GET /search/photos as an alternative, and if it does, must mention the Unsplash API requirements (hotlink photo.urls, call download_location, attribution with utm parameters). Should mention image sizes (src.large for hero) and licensing/attribution info.
